title: phalaris arundinacea var. minor
intro: Phalaris arundinacea var. minor, commonly known as lesser reed grass, is a variety of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is known to have several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and combat infections. The therapeutic actions of Phalaris arundinacea var. minor include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve respiratory issues, and act as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
